core_4h_long_all.sql_where: strategy = 'core' AND interval = '4h' AND label IN ('Buy', 'Strong Buy') AND r_net IS NOT NULL
core_4h_long_all.notes: Baseline ledger swing longs. Confirmed single-deduction net return is +0.2627R (Gross +0.4105R - confirmed costs 0.1479R).

core_4h_long_trending.sql_where: strategy = 'core' AND interval = '4h' AND label IN ('Buy', 'Strong Buy') AND regime IN ('strong_trend', 'weak_trend', 'trending') AND r_net IS NOT NULL
core_4h_long_trending.notes: Core 4h longs executed in trending regimes (18 strong_trend + 133 weak_trend).

core_4h_long_ranging.sql_where: strategy = 'core' AND interval = '4h' AND label IN ('Buy', 'Strong Buy') AND regime IN ('range', 'ranging') AND r_net IS NOT NULL
core_4h_long_ranging.notes: Core 4h longs in ranging regimes (29 trades). Target-limit maker exits incurred 0 slippage, matching ledger cost.

core_4h_long_choppy.sql_where: strategy = 'core' AND interval = '4h' AND label IN ('Buy', 'Strong Buy') AND regime IN ('high_vol', 'squeeze', 'choppy', 'chop') AND r_net IS NOT NULL
core_4h_long_choppy.notes: Core 4h longs executed in high volatility / squeeze regimes (9 high_vol + 2 squeeze).

flash_short_burst.sql_where: strategy = 'flash' AND label IN ('Sell', 'Strong Sell') AND r_net IS NOT NULL
flash_short_burst.notes: Flash short burst trades (19 on 15m, 106 on 1h; all paper shadow=True). Flipped negative under confirmed fee drag.

flash_long_burst.sql_where: strategy = 'flash' AND label IN ('Buy', 'Strong Buy') AND r_net IS NOT NULL
flash_long_burst.notes: Flash long burst trades (30 on 15m, 449 on 1h; all paper shadow=True).

core_short_all.sql_where: strategy = 'core' AND label IN ('Sell', 'Strong Sell') AND r_net IS NOT NULL
core_short_all.notes: All Core short trades across 1d (4), 1h (65), and 4h (51). Market composition: Forex (69), Crypto (45), Commodities (2), Rates (2), Indices (2).
